text.pages_rule: 12n-1 supply (12n-1); packed 254 content pages, guide p.5 suggests 263 -- blank padding not supplied at the owner's request
text.page_fit_note: master 209.9 x 269.9 mm is smaller than the 216 x 279 mm trim and its edges carry detail (worst step 122/255). Enlarging it to reach the cut would push its text out of the 20 mm gutter, so the page is placed 1:1: the outer 3.06 mm (sides) and 4.54 mm (top and bottom) of the printed page carry a soft continuation of the page edge. Re-export this master at 216 x 279 mm to remove it
text.content_shift_note: content moved 3.1 mm toward the outer edge and 0.0 mm down: closest live text is now 21.0 mm off the gutter (was 17.9), 10.9 mm from the outer trim (was 13.9) and 9.0 mm from the top trim (their rules: 20 mm gutter, 5 mm trim; tightest page 152, 14.9 mm off the gutter)
text.note: kept RGB: 64 Type 3 fonts block Ghostscript's CMYK conversion (guide p.6 accepts RGB, their preflight converts); transparency left on 23 pages (the flattening pass could not clear it)

checks.name: Last page is clear for their barcode
checks.detail: the final page is blank, so the barcode they add lands on nothing

checks.name: Cover pages stripped from the interior
checks.detail: the front cover and the back cover are removed: they belong in the cover file, and leaving them in prints the cover twice

checks.name: All fonts embedded
checks.detail: every font is embedded (guide p.3)

checks.name: No Type 3 glyph-program fonts
checks.detail: 64 Type 3 fonts. These carry headings as drawing programs instead of an embedded font, so preflight rates them lowest of all font types, and Ghostscript 10.02.1 segfaults converting them to CMYK -- this book therefore stays RGB, which BookVault accept and convert themselves

checks.name: Transparency flattened
checks.detail: 23 pages still carry it (page 12: transparency group); Ghostscript's flattening pass ran and left it in place, so it has to be cleared before a print run (guide p.3)

checks.name: Images at 300 DPI or better
checks.detail: 174 below 300 DPI, e.g. page 6: 150 DPI; page 10: 150 DPI; page 11: 150 DPI

checks.name: Artwork covers the printed area
checks.detail: 508 pages carry a soft continuation of the page edge up to 4.5 mm inside the trim: this master is smaller than the trim and cannot be enlarged without losing its gutter margin (see the page-size line above) -- re-export it at 216 x 279 mm to print artwork to the cut

checks.name: Binding-edge clearance
